title: Contributor Lifecycle Compass: Onboarding, Role Ladders, and Benefit Navigation
summary: One reference for the contributor lifecycle at Redwood: hiring and early onboarding, role ladders and promotion criteria, benefits enrollment windows, and day-to-day use of internal tools. It brings checklists, handoffs and measurable expectations together so hiring managers, people-ops partners and new joiners work from the same playbook.
body:
Overview:

This page pulls together the processes and living artifacts that take contributors from offer acceptance to promotion or transition. It focuses on measurable expectations, clean handoffs and tool-backed checkpoints. Treat it as the canonical flow; team-specific variations should link back here.

Key principles:
- One source of truth for lifecycle milestones (offer -> 1:1 cadence -> calibration -> promotion).
- Low friction: default tool flows and templates for access, training and ramp.
- Transparency: promotion criteria are written down and evidence lives in the calibration workspace.
- Safety net: defined reboarding and off-boarding steps.

1) Hiring & Offer -> First 2 Weeks (Rapid Enablement):
- Owner: hiring manager with the people-ops onboarding partner.
- New joiner goals: get account access, join key meetings, merge a first change, finish compliance training.
- First-week checklist:
  1. Day 0: equipment shipped, credentials email sent, RBAC access request opened (owner: IT).
  2. Day 1: welcome standup with the manager; walk through the Role Brief and 90-day milestones.
  3. Day 2–3: core tool walkthrough (Git, infra CLI, CI dashboard, internal docs) with a buddy.
  4. Day 4–5: small end-to-end task assigned and merged.
  5. End of week 1: 30-minute sync with people-ops on benefits enrollment and payroll setup.

2) 30/60/90 Ramping Framework:
- 30 days: know codebase ownership boundaries, submit 1 non-trivial PR, finish mandatory security/evals.
- 60 days: own a small feature or operational runbook; shadow incident rotations as an observer.
- 90 days: ship a scoped project or internal tool, write up lessons learned; manager files the 90-day review.

3) Role Ladders & Promotion Criteria (engineering ladder, condensed):
- L1 - Associate Contributor: contributes to team tasks, seeks feedback.
- L2 - Contributor: ships features with guidance, solid craft and code reviews.
- L3 - Senior Contributor: owns medium-sized areas, mentors, shapes design decisions.
- L4 - Staff/Principal: cross-team impact, technical strategy, measurable product/infra improvements.

Promotion evidence checklist (minimum):
- Three cross-functional artifacts (design doc, postmortem, shipped project).
- At least 4 documented peer reviews with substantive feedback.
- Manager narrative mapped to rubric sections (craft, impact, leadership, scope).

Calibration process:
1. Manager gathers evidence in the calibration workspace (/calibration-workspace).
2. People-ops schedules the panel and sends the rubric 7 days ahead.
3. Panel ratifies the level and writes feedback; people-ops records the outcome and next steps.

4) Benefits & Perks Reference:
- Enrollment windows:
  - Health/Dental/Vision: enroll within 30 days of start date for full coverage; annual open enrollment each November.
  - 401(k): Auto-enroll opt-out within 14 days; match policy on the benefits portal.
  - Parental leave and family support: notify people-ops at least 60 days before planned leave where possible.

- Quick actions:
  - Health plan enrollment: benefits.redwood/internal/enroll (SSN and dependent documents required).
  - Commuter and home office stipend: claim through the expense portal within 90 days of purchase.

5) Internal Tools & Access:
- Primary tools:
  - git (code hosting): repo naming convention rwd-<team>-<service>.
  - infra-cli: infra-cli auth login --team <team> ; infra-cli request-access --resource <resource> --reason "onboarding"
  - SSO portal: sso.redwood/corp -> request MFA device enrollment if not auto-provisioned.
  - Console dashboards: console.redwood/models and console.redwood/billing (manager-level view).

- RBAC access template (paste into infra-cli ticket):
  "Request: repo access
   Team: <team>
   Repo: rwd-<team>-<service>
   Role requested: write
   Justification: <first week task>
   Expiration: 90d"

- Local dev setup (bash):
  curl -fsSL https://internal.redwood/install-dev.sh | bash
  infra-cli auth login --sso
  make workspace-setup

6) Manager Handover & Role Transition Playbook:
- Triggers: manager change, role expansion, internal transfer.
- Steps:
  1. Outgoing manager completes the Handover Form (/handover-templates) within 5 business days.
  2. Hold 3 overlap sessions (context, active projects, people).
  3. Update ownership in repo/team manifests and on-call schedules.
  4. People-ops confirms compensation/benefit continuity and updates payroll if needed.

7) Onboarding SLOs and Escalation Paths:
- Targets:
  - 95% of new joiners have core tool access within 72 hours of start.
  - 90% finish mandatory compliance training in the first 7 days.
  - 80% merge a PR within 14 calendar days.

- If an SLO is missed:
  1. Notify the people-ops onboarding partner and hiring manager.
  2. Still unresolved after 48 hours: escalate to the Head of People-ops.
  3. Record the incident and update the onboarding runbook with the root cause.

8) Reboarding and Returnship Guide:
- Goal: lower cognitive load for returners and shorten restart time.
- 4-week staged plan: admin reactivation (week 0), buddy pairing and sandbox tasks (week 1), project ramp and syncs (weeks 2–4).

9) Knowledge Capture & Handoffs:
- Every role has a 1-page role brief covering responsibilities, active projects and deadlines, key stakeholders and channels, and on-call expectations with runbook links.

10) Ownership and Contact Points:
- People-ops onboarding partner: Asha Patel (primary).
- Hiring escalation: Marco Ruiz (Head of Talent).
- Benefits and payroll: payroll@redwood.internal.

Appendix — Access Matrix:
| Resource                  | Default Owner         | Typical Access Granted | Time-bound by default | Request command example |
|-------------------------: | --------------------- | ---------------------: | --------------------: | ----------------------- |
| Code repos (team)         | Team lead             | write                 | 90d                  | infra-cli request-access --resource repo:rwd-team-service |
| Production infra (K8s)    | Platform SRE          | read                 | 30d                  | infra-cli request-access --resource cluster:<name> --role read |
| Billing console           | Finance lead          | view                 | 365d                 | request via console.redwood/billing |

Related pages and templates:
- Handover templates: /templates/handover-form
- Calibration workspace: /calibration-workspace
- Onboarding checklist canonical: /onboarding/checklist-central

Document maintenance:
- Reviewed quarterly (next review 2028-12-15).
- Submit changes as a pull request against this page in the docs repo and ping people-ops for approval.

Feedback or corrections: People-ops board (board id: PEOPLE-2028) or people-ops@redwood.internal.
